name: Bell of Dethmoora
label: Quest
description: Bell of Dethmoora: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A Bell of Dethmoora, named after the late warlock Dethmoora Darkeyes, is one of the three tools needed to create a Circle of Greater Summoning. When properly atuned with the Wheel and the Candle, these items conduct vast stores of arcane power.
My servant Gorzeeki can construct such a bell, but to do so he will need a large supply of elixirs of shadow power. Procure the elixirs from an alchemist and bring them to Gorzeeki.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have those elixirs, friend? Mor'zul told me you need a Bell of Dethmoora, and making one of those takes a lot of shadow power!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good! I hope these elixirs weren't too hard to get. Sometimes alchemists can be so miserly with their creations...
I'll make the bell and keep it until you're ready for your ritual.
